name: arpg-test-game
description: Hollow Wake — a data-driven top-down action RPG (TypeScript + Canvas 2D + Electron).
author: Arianna

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.launcher.json && tsc -p tsconfig.sim.json && tsc -p tsconfig.shard.json
scripts.test:reliability: tsx balance/probe_savewriteorder.ts && tsx balance/probe_sharedstructures.ts && tsx balance/probe_altar_bodies.ts && tsx balance/check_loadingpresentation.ts
scripts.test:reliability:ui: electron balance/menu-tray-ui.cjs && electron balance/loading-screen-ui.cjs && electron balance/loading-isolation-ui.cjs
scripts.test:layers: tsx balance/layer-integrity-check.ts && tsx balance/layer-native-check.ts && electron balance/layer-visual-ui.cjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/make-build-info.mjs && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/make-build-info.mjs && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && node scripts/make-build-info.mjs && electron-builder --win --linux --publish never
